import statistics

# Data for FY 1953 to FY 1962 (from the tables)
# Gold ($35 per fine ounce) - independent variable (X)
# Silver ($1.29+ per fine ounce) - dependent variable (Y)

years = [1953, 1954, 1955, 1956, 1957, 1958, 1959, 1960, 1961, 1962]
gold = [22462.8, 21927.0, 21677.6, 21799.1, 22622.9, 21356.2, 19704.6, 19322.2, 17550.2, 16435.2]
silver = [3814.3, 3863.1, 3922.4, 3994.5, 4116.6, 4306.0, 4414.1, 4394.5, 4346.5, 4317.4]

print("Data for FY 1953 to FY 1962:")
print("Year | Gold ($M) | Silver ($M)")
for i, year in enumerate(years):
    print(f"{year} | {gold[i]} | {silver[i]}")

# Calculate means
n = len(gold)
mean_gold = sum(gold) / n
mean_silver = sum(silver) / n

print(f"\nMean Gold: {mean_gold}")
print(f"Mean Silver: {mean_silver}")

# Calculate slope (b) and intercept (a) using least squares
# b = Σ((x - x̄)(y - ȳ)) / Σ((x - x̄)²)
# a = ȳ - b * x̄

numerator = sum((gold[i] - mean_gold) * (silver[i] - mean_silver) for i in range(n))
denominator = sum((gold[i] - mean_gold) ** 2 for i in range(n))

slope = numerator / denominator
intercept = mean_silver - slope * mean_gold

print(f"\nSlope: {slope}")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept}")

# Calculate R-squared
# First, calculate predicted values
predicted = [intercept + slope * gold[i] for i in range(n)]

# Calculate SS_res (residual sum of squares)
ss_res = sum((silver[i] - predicted[i]) ** 2 for i in range(n))

# Calculate SS_tot (total sum of squares)
ss_tot = sum((silver[i] - mean_silver) ** 2 for i in range(n))

# R-squared = 1 - (SS_res / SS_tot)
r_squared = 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)

print(f"\nR-squared: {r_squared}")
print(f"R-squared (rounded to 2 decimal places): {round(r_squared, 2)}")
